node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope to the same displayed A,w and the nonempty sets U,V,R. It gives A_R as an extended L^0*epsilon-C*-algebra, every relevant projection P_U,P_V,P_R the separate c0*epsilon projection bound, and every subordination and complementarity error for U subseteq R (with R minus U=V) at most L^0*epsilon. Enlarging only the ambient tolerance from L^0*epsilon to epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon using the defining inequalities of def-epsilon-cstar-algebra and def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra certifies the literal Stage-3 target A_R as an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra; the projection scale c0*epsilon remains separate.
